zh.title: 瑞士航空LX1255因機上醫療緊急狀況轉降漢堡　後續續飛蘇黎世
zh.summary: 瑞士航空LX1255昨日（10月13日）由斯德哥爾摩飛往蘇黎世途中，因機上醫療緊急狀況轉降漢堡。受影響旅客交由醫療人員照護後，客機加油並續飛蘇黎世。
body: 瑞士國際航空（SWISS）一架執行LX1255航班的Airbus A320neo客機，昨日（2026年10月13日）上午由斯德哥爾摩阿蘭達機場（ARN）飛往蘇黎世機場（ZRH）途中，因機上發生醫療緊急狀況，轉降德國漢堡機場（HAM）。航班追蹤資料顯示，執飛客機註冊編號為HB-JDH，當日完成轉降後續飛蘇黎世。
AirNav Radar的緊急事件列表將該班機轉降漢堡後的到站時間列為當地上午07:58，即中歐夏令時間（CEST，UTC+2），換算臺北時間為10月13日下午01:58。該網站將這項時間資料標示為依航空公司或機場資訊取得的到站時間，並非可直接當作精確接地時間的紀錄；其個別航班頁面另列08:15，公開頁面之間仍有差異，因此本文僅確認轉降發生於當地上午約8時。
根據德國新聞社（dpa）報導，瑞士航空發言人證實，機上共有156名乘客，受影響的旅客在漢堡交由醫療人員照護。航空公司表示，機組人員發出緊急訊號，以便盡量避免延誤降落；客機加油後安排繼續飛往原定目的地。
Flightradar24當日亦通報，LX1255在漢堡附近下降時發送7700電碼。7700是航空器應答機使用的通用緊急代碼，供航管辨識航機處於緊急狀況，單憑電碼無法判斷具體原因；本次轉降原因則已由航空公司確認為醫療緊急狀況。
依Flightradar24的HB-JDH飛航紀錄，客機於10月13日漢堡當地時間上午08:50起飛，並於蘇黎世當地時間上午09:48降落；兩地當日均使用中歐夏令時間（CEST，UTC+2），相當於UTC時間06:50及07:48，換算臺北時間分別為下午02:50與下午03:48。公開報導未揭露該名旅客的具體病況及後續醫療結果。

en.title: SWISS LX1255 Diverts to Hamburg for Medical Emergency Before Continuing to Zurich
en.summary: SWISS flight LX1255 diverted to Hamburg yesterday, October 13, following a medical emergency on its Stockholm–Zurich service. The affected passenger received medical care, and the aircraft refuelled before continuing to Zurich.
body: A SWISS Airbus A320neo operating flight LX1255 from Stockholm Arlanda Airport (ARN) to Zurich Airport (ZRH) diverted to Hamburg Airport (HAM), Germany, yesterday morning, October 13, 2026, following a medical emergency on board. Flight-tracking records identify the aircraft as HB-JDH and show that it continued to Zurich later that day.

AirNav Radar's emergency alert list records the Hamburg arrival at 07:58 local time, Central European Summer Time (CEST, UTC+2), equivalent to 13:58 in Taipei on October 13. The site labels this as an arrival-at-gate time derived from airline or airport information, rather than a precise touchdown time. Its individual flight page separately shows 08:15. Given that discrepancy between public pages, this article places the diversion at approximately 08:00 local time without asserting an exact touchdown minute.

According to German news agency dpa, a SWISS spokesperson confirmed that 156 passengers were on board and that the affected passenger was handed over to medical personnel in Hamburg. The airline said the crew transmitted an emergency signal to minimise delays to landing and planned to continue to the original destination after refuelling.

Flightradar24 also reported that LX1255 transmitted transponder code 7700 while descending near Hamburg that day. This general emergency code alerts air traffic control to an emergency but does not identify its cause. In this case, the airline confirmed that the diversion resulted from a medical emergency.

Flightradar24's flight history for HB-JDH records take-off from Hamburg at 08:50 local time on October 13 and landing in Zurich at 09:48 local time. Both airports were observing CEST (UTC+2), corresponding to 06:50 and 07:48 UTC, or 14:50 and 15:48 in Taipei. Public reports did not disclose the passenger's specific condition or subsequent medical outcome.
